translations.web: For now I would have stretched out my hand, and struck you and your people with pestilence, and you would have been cut off from the earth;
translations.bsb: For by this time I could have stretched out My hand and struck you and your people with a plague to wipe you off the earth.
translations.kjv: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
translations.asv: For now I had put forth my hand, and smitten thee and thy people with pestilence, and thou hadst been cut off from the earth:
